name: Siemens Aktiengesellschaft
summary: Siemens Aktiengesellschaft, a technology company, focuses in the areas of automation and digitalization across the world. It operates through Digital Industries, Smart Infrastructure, Mobility, Siemens Healthineers, and Siemens Financial Services (SFS) segments.
